_comment: Ten defects, each a one-line change in a different stage of the pipeline, each breaking one or more published conformance cases. kata.py build injects them; kata.py verify-manifest fills in which cases each breaks. Participants are not meant to read this file until they have fixed the case; kata.py hint names the stage and kata.py reveal names the line.

defects.why: estimate-utf8/v1 is UTF-8 bytes divided by four, rounded up. Rounding down undercounts every text by up to one token, so payloads fit that must not and every traced count is wrong.
Exact deduplication compares bodies after collapsing every run of whitespace to one space and trimming the ends (R-24). Comparing raw bodies lets a copy with different spacing through.
Supersession keeps the latest observation per producer and source and excludes the older ones (R-25). Keeping the oldest inverts it: the stale observation stays and the fresh one goes.
Protected items and conflict-group members are never excluded and take places first, even beyond the cap (R-26). If they take no places, the cap admits that many extra items.

Prior turns render in the order they were said: by freshness compared as instants, then by id (R-7). Ordering by id alone breaks any conversation whose ids do not sort like its clock, and with it every cache prefix.

Every string ordering in the specification is by UTF-16 code units, as RFC 8785 orders member names, so that Python, Go, Rust and JavaScript agree. UTF-8 byte order differs from it above the Basic Multilingual Plane.

defects.find: if item.expires is not None and instants.compare(item.expires, ctx.snapshot.assembly_time) <= 0:
defects.replace: if item.expires is not None and instants.compare(item.expires, ctx.snapshot.assembly_time) < 0:
defects.why: An item whose expires is at or before assembly_time is expired (R-9): equal means expired. Treating the boundary as live admits a memory the producer meant to be gone at that instant.

defects.find: return "below_threshold" if minimum is not None and (item.relevance is None or item.relevance < minimum) else None
defects.replace: return "below_threshold" if minimum is not None and (item.relevance is None or item.relevance <= minimum) else None
defects.why: A score equal to the route's min_relevance passes (R-13). A strict comparison excludes the item that sits exactly on the threshold.

The margin charge rounds up, however small its fraction: a payload fits only when count times (100 plus margin) over 100, rounded up, is at most budget.input (R-16). Rounding down lets a payload one fraction of a token over the line through.

defects.find: if any(key not in item.scope for key in required) or any(request.get(k) != v for k, v in item.scope.items()):
defects.replace: if any(request.get(k) != v for k, v in item.scope.items()):
defects.why: An item that lacks a key its slot's required_scope lists is out of scope; a missing key is never a wildcard (R-2). Dropping the check admits an item that said nothing about whose it is.
